name: carousel
description: A source-owned scroll-snap Carousel for Dioxus with no dedicated primitive dependency.

documentation.compositionNote: Built directly on native CSS scroll-snap plus Dioxus's own per-element MountedData::scroll/onscroll -- no drag/swipe gesture and no new adico-primitives module, matching this repo's own precedent for resizable's similarly reduced-primitive-need shape. Deliberately does not replicate embla-carousel-react's full API (CarouselApi/setApi, dot indicators, autoplay plugins, loop mode) -- see this file's own module doc comment and the M7 task audit (openspec/changes/build-adico-component-ecosystem/tasks.md, task 8.1) for why momentum drag was scoped out (adico-primitives' pointer.rs global pointer-position registry is a documented, unconfirmed-in-browser defect on web).
documentation.accessibility: Carousel is role="region" aria-roledescription="carousel"; each CarouselItem is role="group" aria-roledescription="slide". CarouselPrevious/CarouselNext are real disabled buttons (not just visually dimmed) once already at the corresponding scroll edge.
documentation.keyboard: CarouselContent itself is focusable (tabindex="0"); ArrowLeft/ArrowRight (or ArrowUp/ArrowDown when orientation is Vertical) page one viewport in that direction. CarouselPrevious/CarouselNext provide the same paging by click.
